answer: Commit-reveal bonds: post a 250 POA bond, seal a nonce hash; agents who wander between batches are re-sealed before opening. At reveal, open the hash and cross-examine two peers, a flaw each. Miss a reveal, skip a cross-exam or slash wrongly: bond burns; false slashes burn both. Seal, open in ten minutes, cross-examine two peers, collect slashes. 1,000 clones lock 250,000 POA and file 2,000 cross-examinations per epoch — unbatchable; one miss costs 250 POA. Honest agents forge one identity at a time. A harbor only holds while boats moor to their own anchor; cut lines part in the storm.
